changelog: Import setup works and Pair with code is in Settings
Backend address typed by hand is validated; the token is cleared when the host changes
Re-importing the same setup no longer asks to pair again
Import setup works (it failed silently in 0.2.0)
Import setup and Pair with code are the first Settings items; readable errors
Keyboard Go/Done submits; Back keeps the dialog open
First signed release. If you installed 0.1.0, uninstall it once first.
